argv:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$HOME/.local/share/bridge-comand-bootstrap"
if [ ! -d "$ROOT/.git" ]; then git clone https://github.com/One-Wave-Universe/Bridge-Comand.git "$ROOT"; fi
git -C "$ROOT" fetch --prune origin main
git -C "$ROOT" checkout --detach origin/main
export ONE_WAVE_PROJECT_ROOT=/home/Scales/One-Wave-Science
bash "$ROOT/hive-pipe/bootstrap_chatgpt_terminal_pull.sh"
systemctl --user enable one-wave-chatgpt-terminal-pull.service one-wave-bridge-lattice-watchdog.timer one-wave-route-goblin.timer
systemctl --user restart one-wave-chatgpt-terminal-pull.service
printf 'JETSON_INDEPENDENT_BRIDGE_RECOVERY_OK\n'
systemctl --user is-active one-wave-chatgpt-terminal-pull.service
systemctl --user is-active one-wave-bridge-lattice-watchdog.timer
systemctl --user is-active one-wave-route-goblin.timer
git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse HEAD
intention: Restore the Jetson GitHub pull, Hive Pipe, watchdog, and Route Goblin control plane with no Desktop Commander dependency.
consequence: Updates Bridge-Comand runtime from main, installs/enables boot-persistent bridge services, and emits explicit service receipts.
